prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when Driver 1 moved toward the right lane and made contact with the side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2. The contact was a sideswipe, and both vehicles came to rest on the shoulder. Responding officers spoke with Driver 1, Driver 2, and two independent witnesses, all of whom described the collision in the same sequence. Photographs taken at the scene show damage along the right side of Driver 1's vehicle and the left side of Driver 2's vehicle, consistent with the reported impact. Driver 1 is listed on the auto policy for the vehicle involved. A Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time, and both the witnesses and the officers confirmed the Passenger's presence. No prior damage to either vehicle was noted in the records reviewed. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and was transported for evaluation. At this time it is not clear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision, and the medical findings will need to be reviewed before a determination is made.
